refusal_reason: The PDF is readable (11 pages, all read) but is not a reliable source: page 1 is the official Hindawi retraction notice (published 12 July 2023, Article ID 9830141, DOI 10.1155/2023/9830141) retracting Lei Wang, 'Sports Feedback System Based on Video Digital Processing' (2022, Article ID 2859567, DOI 10.1155/2022/2859567). The publisher states the investigation 'uncovered evidence of one or more of the following indicators of systematic manipulation of the publication process', including discrepancies in scope, discrepancies between data availability and research described, inappropriate citations, 'Incoherent, meaningless and/or irrelevant content included in the article', and peer-review manipulation, and that it 'cannot, therefore, vouch for its reliability'. The retracted body (pages 2-11, every page watermarked RETRACTED) exhibits exactly that incoherence: a '6000 Ma' battery claimed to 'work for 6000 days'; positioning accuracy of 99.99% with '5.4 million full network coverage' base stations; EEG recording threads and 90-280 V AC mains power-supply circuitry irrelevant to the described battery-powered video feedback system; Eq. (10) redefines the standard-deviation symbol delta(z) as the data-completeness percentage R/K x 100%, contradicting Eqs. (6)-(9) where the same symbol is a standard deviation (dimensional incoherence); the abstract claims 32 s response time while Section 5.2 reports 23 s at 1000 records; the 'Bessel formula' is conflated with Bessel functions; references include two withdrawn papers and irrelevant citations (superconducting magnet databases, ASR prosody). Extracting sovereign primitives from this text would launder publisher-declared unreliable, manipulated content into the Foundry corpus. No trustworthy source content is available for extraction; honest refusal per doctrine rather than fabrication.
universal_lens: Source-integrity gate: a readable PDF is not a reliable source. Publisher retraction for systematic manipulation plus internal dimensional and numerical contradictions disqualify extraction regardless of text availability.
gsi_mapping: No clinical or physiological invariant can be certified from a retracted, manipulated source; admitting it would contaminate downstream GSI telemetry models with fabricated hardware and error-statistics claims.
gse_mapping: No Coach-Mind, deception, or portfolio invariant is extracted; the retracted system's error-convergence and data-integrity claims are internally contradictory and publisher-declared unreliable, so they are barred from GSE engine queues.
